name: Anabel del Val
research_summary: del Val studies how uncertainty affects predictions of very fast, hot, chemically reacting gas flows. She uses statistical and data-based methods to improve models, identify influential inputs, and design more informative experiments.

quiz.question: What aspect of flow predictions does Anabel del Val primarily study?
choices: Their speed and velocity.
Their chemical properties.
How uncertainty affects them.
Their temperature variations.

quiz.question: Do Anabel del Val's research interests include chemically reacting gas flows?
choices: No, she focuses only on non-reactive flows.
Yes, specifically very fast, hot ones.
Only theoretical, not practical, applications.
Rarely, only when they are very slow.
quiz.answer: Yes, specifically very fast, hot ones.

quiz.question: Which types of methods does del Val use to handle uncertainty in her models?
choices: Computational fluid dynamics and simulations.
Analytical and theoretical physics methods.
Statistical and data-based methods.
Observational and empirical methods.

quiz.question: What is the primary reason Anabel del Val identifies influential model inputs?
choices: To make the models run faster.
To understand which inputs most affect predictions.
To minimize the overall number of inputs.
To increase the complexity of the models.
quiz.answer: To understand which inputs most affect predictions.

quiz.question: When designing experiments, what does Anabel del Val aim to improve?
choices: Their cost-effectiveness.
The speed at which they can be performed.
How much useful information they provide.
The variety of temperature and pressure conditions.
quiz.answer: How much useful information they provide.
